relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a boy with Blau syndrome carrying a NOD2 variant: "A mutation in codon 1000 C > T (protein R334W) in the NOD2 gene was discovered."
method_note: Read the whole paper and built the JSON by hand-entered values in a short Python script (no table transcription by script). One in-scope person (label 'patient', rule 5). The mother is mentioned only as sharing heterochromia of the right eye and as having 'no known history of NOD2 mutation or sarcoidosis'; she was neither tested nor affected with Blau syndrome, so she gets no row; that statement is not parental testing, so inheritance and parental_testing_statement are 'not reported'. Variant printed as 'codon 1000 C > T (protein R334W)': no 'c.' or 'p.' prefix and no transcript; cdna_hgvs_as_stated left null because the printed form is 'codon 1000 C > T', not c. notation; protein recorded as printed 'R334W'. Zygosity, variant type and pathogenicity not stated. Age at onset taken as the 13-month presentation of the eruption; the paper says falls, conjunctival injection and joint/eye pain began 'prior to presentation to dermatology' without an age. Age at diagnosis taken from Table 1 '15 months | NOD2 mutation discovered' (genetic diagnosis). Age at last evaluation from Table 1's last row (30 months). Vital status left 'not reported' (no explicit statement, although the patient is described as continuing treatment). Normal IgG recorded as excluded 'abnormal serum IgG level'; negative T-spot as excluded 'positive T-spot'. Skin-biopsy immunostains (S100/CD1a negative, CD163 positive) and negative infection stains, and the negative testing of >95 other immunodeficiency genes, were not recorded as phenotypic features. 'Visual impairment or blindness' left not reported although 'blurry vision' was denied (narrower absence). Respiratory symptoms denied do not exclude interstitial lung disease. Joint pain and eye pain are hedged in the paper ('apparent'). Uveitis is stated via 'conjunctival injection consistent with uveitis' and Table 1; slit lamp examination was not tolerated. No contradictions found.
